slo_title: Understand Doubly Linked Lists - Insertion at the beginning and the end

mcq.q: If a node is inserted at the end of an empty doubly linked list, which pointers are set to NULL

options.A: The new node’s next and previous pointers
options.B: Only the next pointer of the new node
options.C: Only the previous pointer of the new node
options.D: No pointer is set to NULL

mcq.answer_text: The new node’s next and previous pointers

mcq.q: Which of the following correctly represents the sequence of operations when inserting a node at the beginning of a doubly linked list

options.A: Update new node’s previous → Update new node’s next → Update head’s previous → Move head pointer
options.B: Update head’s next → Update tail’s previous → Move head pointer
options.C: Delete tail → Update new node’s next → Update head
options.D: Move head pointer → Update tail pointer

mcq.answer_text: Update new node’s previous → Update new node’s next → Update head’s previous → Move head pointer

mcq.q: Which situation requires updating the tail pointer when inserting into a doubly linked list
In a circular doubly linked list, when inserting a node at the end, which additional pointer is updated compared to a normal doubly linked list

options.A: The new node’s next pointer is set to head
options.B: The new node’s previous pointer is set to NULL
options.C: The head’s next pointer is updated

mcq.answer_text: The new node’s next pointer is set to head

mcq.q: When inserting a node at the beginning of a doubly linked list, which pointer(s) must be updated

options.A: Only the next pointer of the new node
options.B: Only the previous pointer of the new node
options.C: The next pointer of the new node and the previous pointer of the old head

mcq.answer_text: The next pointer of the new node and the previous pointer of the old head
